acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring high-quality paint and finish in an addition involves meticulous preparation and application. This includes thoroughly cleaning and priming all surfaces, proper caulking and patching, and applying multiple thin coats of paint rather than fewer thick ones. In the East Bay, particularly Berkeley, where homes often have diverse architectural styles, attention to detail in matching or complementing existing trim and architectural features is crucial. Our process includes a final walk-through to ensure all finishes meet your expectations and our quality standards before project completion, which is a key first-party insight into our commitment.
